"""Validate and summarize the frozen exploratory all-gather registration pair."""
import importlib.util
import json
import statistics
from pathlib import Path

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("collector", "/tmp/hero2_current_collect_arm.py")
collector = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(collector)
state = json.loads(Path(Path("/tmp/hero-reverse-study-state-path.txt").read_text()).read_text())
precheck = json.loads(Path("/tmp/hero-reverse-p1-precheck.json").read_text())
assert len(state["arms"]) == 2 and all(a["state"] == "succeeded" for a in state["arms"])
assert state["checkpoint_pins"]["1"]["status"] == "released"
assert set(precheck["arms"]) == {"control", "allgather"}

probes = {}
for line in Path("/tmp/hero-reverse-analysis-results.log").read_text().splitlines():
    marker = "HERO_NATIVE_ANALYSIS_RESULT "
    if marker not in line:
        continue
    record = json.loads(line.split(marker, 1)[1])
    data, probe = record["result"], record["probe"]
    source = data["treatment"]["source"] if probe == "hlo" else data["source"]
    run = source.split("/xprof/", 1)[1].split("/", 1)[0]
    run_probes = probes.setdefault(run, {})
    assert probe not in run_probes
    run_probes[probe] = data
assert set(probes) == {a["run_id"] for a in state["arms"]}
control_run = next(a["run_id"] for a in state["arms"] if a["arm"] == "control")
arms = {}
for submission in state["arms"]:
    label, run = submission["arm"], submission["run_id"]
    prefix = f"/tmp/hero-reverse-p1-{label}"
    data = probes[run]
    assert set(data) == {"profile", "hlo", "memcpy"}
    profile, hlo = data["profile"], data["hlo"]
    assert hlo["control"]["source"].split("/xprof/", 1)[1].split("/", 1)[0] == control_run
    assert hlo["treatment"]["source"] == profile["source"] == data["memcpy"]["source"]
    assert profile["program_id"] == data["memcpy"]["program_id"]
    assert hlo["treatment"]["metadata_name"] == f'jit_train_step({profile["program_id"]})'
    backward = profile["profile_backward_launch_histogram"]
    assert sum(r["calls"] for r in backward) == 96
    assert all(r["group"] == "fa4_backward_native" and "flashattentionbackwardsm100" in r["name"].lower() for r in backward)
    ragged = profile["ragged_launch_histogram"]
    assert sum(r["calls"] for r in ragged) == 1152
    assert all("grid:32,1,1" in r["metadata"]["kernel_details"] and "block:512,1,1" in r["metadata"]["kernel_details"] for r in ragged)
    for group in profile["groups"]:
        assert 0 <= group["outside_other_gpu_work_seconds"] <= group["union_seconds"] + 1e-9
    rows = {}
    for line, payload, _ in collector.payloads(prefix + "-metrics.jsonl"):
        assert collector.identity(line, submission["child"])[0] == 0
        row = rows.setdefault(payload["step"], {})
        for key, value in payload["metrics"].items():
            assert key not in row or row[key] == value
            row[key] = value
    cp = precheck["arms"][label]["checkpoint"]
    assert cp["benchmark_checkpoint"] == state["checkpoint_pins"]["1"]["checkpoint"]
    start = cp["checkpoint_step"]
    assert f"/steps-{start + 5}-to-{start + 7}/" in profile["source"]
    assert set(rows) == set(range(start, start + 28))
    samples = [{"step": step, "relative_step": step - start, **rows[step]} for step in sorted(rows)]
    scored = [r["throughput/duration"] for r in samples if 8 <= r["relative_step"] <= 27]
    assert len(scored) == 20
    assert statistics.mean(scored) == precheck["arms"][label]["mean_scored_seconds"]
    manifests = collector.manifests(prefix + "-attention-manifest.log", "HERO_REGISTRATION_RUNTIME", submission["child"])
    for name, value in data.items():
        Path(prefix + "-" + name + ".json").write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    arms[label] = {"submission": submission, "checkpoint": cp, "rack": precheck["arms"][label]["rack"], "runtime_manifests": manifests, "samples": samples, "mean_scored_seconds": statistics.mean(scored), "profiles": data}

c, t = arms["control"], arms["allgather"]
assert c["profiles"]["hlo"]["control"] == c["profiles"]["hlo"]["treatment"] == t["profiles"]["hlo"]["control"]
assert c["checkpoint"] == t["checkpoint"] and c["rack"] == t["rack"]
assert [a["arm"] for a in sorted(state["arms"], key=lambda a:a["submitted_utc"])] == state["protocol"]["orders"][0]
losses = [{"step": left["step"], "control": left["train/loss"], "allgather": right["train/loss"], "difference": right["train/loss"] - left["train/loss"]} for left, right in zip(c["samples"], t["samples"], strict=True)]
delta = [r["difference"] for r in losses]
memory = {}
for label, arm in arms.items():
    allocations = arm["profiles"]["hlo"]["treatment"]["allocation_size_totals_by_color"]
    assert {"0", "1", "5"} <= allocations.keys()
    memory[label] = {"gib_by_color": {k: v["bytes"] / 2**30 for k, v in allocations.items()}, "default_plus_collective_gib": sum(allocations[k]["bytes"] for k in ("0", "1")) / 2**30}
summary = {"study": state["study"], "design": "One reverse-order exploratory matched pair, allgather then control; score all relative steps 8 through 27.", "control_seconds": c["mean_scored_seconds"], "allgather_seconds": t["mean_scored_seconds"], "throughput_change_percent": 100 * (c["mean_scored_seconds"] / t["mean_scored_seconds"] - 1), "planned_memory": memory, "loss": {"steps": len(delta), "mean_difference": statistics.mean(delta), "max_absolute_difference": max(map(abs, delta)), "first_step_difference": delta[0], "last_step_difference": delta[-1], "trajectory": losses}, "limitations": ["One pair cannot estimate between-run uncertainty; no acceptance confidence interval is reported.", "Loss checks cover only 28 updates and do not establish long-term convergence.", "XPlane kernel durations cover two profiled steps and may overlap; they are not additive wall-time attribution.", "Time outside other captured GPU work is not a causal estimate of critical-path savings.", "HLO allocation totals describe planned memory by color, not physical GPU peak memory."]}
result = {"summary": summary, "protocol": state["protocol"], "checkpoint_pins": state["checkpoint_pins"], "gate_results": state["gate_results"], "arms": arms}
Path("/tmp/hero-reverse-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({**summary, "loss": {k: v for k, v in summary["loss"].items() if k != "trajectory"}}, indent=2))

import json

import sys

from iris.cli.connect import open_iris_client
from iris.cluster.types import JobName

p=argparse.ArgumentParser(); p.add_argument('--pair',type=int);args=p.parse_args()

start=int(datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(state['study'].replace('hero2-registration-','')[:8]+'T00:00:00+00:00').timestamp()*1000)
end=int(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).timestamp()*1000)
with open_iris_client(cluster_name='cw-us-east-08a',workspace=None) as region:
 for arm in state['arms']:
  if args.pair and args.pair!=arm['pair']: continue
  prefix=f"/tmp/hero-reverse-p{arm['pair']}-{arm['arm']}"
  child=arm['child']
  status=region.job_status(JobName.from_wire(child))
  if status.state.value!='succeeded': continue
  assert status.failure_count==status.preemption_count==0
  subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/tmp/hero2_b28_collect_admission.py',arm['run_id'],prefix,arm['job_id']],check=True)
  admission=json.loads(Path(prefix+'-admission.json').read_text())
  Path(prefix+'-terminal.json').write_text(json.dumps({'child':admission},indent=2)+'\n')
  for suffix,substring in [('attention-manifest','HERO_REGISTRATION_RUNTIME'),('checkpoint','benchmark_checkpoint')]:
   with open(prefix+'-'+suffix+'.log','w') as output:
    subprocess.run(['uv','run','--no-sync','iris','--cluster=marin','job','logs',child,'--substring',substring,'--max-lines','1000','--since-ms',str(start),'--no-tail'],check=True,stdout=output)
  query=f'''WITH records AS (
 SELECT seq,key,source,epoch_ms,"cluster",substring(data FROM position('{{' IN data)) AS payload
 FROM "log" WHERE key='{child}/0:0' AND "cluster"='cw-us-east-08a'
 AND epoch_ms >= {start} AND epoch_ms < {end}
 AND contains(data,'[rank0]') AND contains(data,'levanter.json_logger')
 AND (contains(data,'"throughput/duration"') OR contains(data,'"train/loss"'))
)
SELECT seq,key,source,epoch_ms,"cluster",json_get_int(payload,'step') AS step,
 json_get_float(json_get(payload,'metrics'),'throughput/duration') AS duration,
 json_get_float(json_get(payload,'metrics'),'train/loss') AS loss
FROM records WHERE json_get(payload,'event')='log' ORDER BY seq LIMIT 200
'''
  Path(prefix+'-metrics.sql').write_text(query)
  with open(prefix+'-metrics.jsonl','w') as output:
   subprocess.run(['uv','run','--no-sync','finelog','query','marin'],input=query,text=True,stdout=output,check=True)
  Path(prefix+'-submission.json').write_text(json.dumps(arm,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps({'collected':arm['run_id'],'prefix':prefix}),flush=True)

"""Summarize two validated exploratory pairs without treating steps as replicas."""
import json
import statistics
from pathlib import Path

paths = [Path('/tmp/hero-next-results.json'), Path('/tmp/hero-reverse-results.json')]
records = [json.loads(path.read_text()) for path in paths]
pairs = []
for result in records:
    arms = result['arms']
    assert set(arms) == {'control', 'allgather'}
    assert arms['control']['checkpoint'] == arms['allgather']['checkpoint']
    assert arms['control']['rack'] == arms['allgather']['rack']
    assert result['checkpoint_pins']['1']['status'] == 'released'
    pairs.append({
        'study': result['summary']['study'],
        'order': result['protocol']['orders'][0],
        'checkpoint': arms['control']['checkpoint'],
        'rack': arms['control']['rack'],
        'control_seconds': result['summary']['control_seconds'],
        'allgather_seconds': result['summary']['allgather_seconds'],
        'throughput_change_percent': result['summary']['throughput_change_percent'],
        'maximum_absolute_loss_difference': result['summary']['loss']['max_absolute_difference'],
    })
assert [pair['order'] for pair in pairs] == [['control', 'allgather'], ['allgather', 'control']]
for arm in ('control', 'allgather'):
    assert records[0]['protocol'][arm] == records[1]['protocol'][arm]
    assert records[0]['arms'][arm]['runtime_manifests'][0]['runtime'] == records[1]['arms'][arm]['runtime_manifests'][0]['runtime']
control = statistics.mean(pair['control_seconds'] for pair in pairs)
candidate = statistics.mean(pair['allgather_seconds'] for pair in pairs)
summary = {
    'pairs': pairs,
    'mean_control_seconds': control,
    'mean_allgather_seconds': candidate,
    'aggregate_throughput_change_percent': 100 * (control / candidate - 1),
    'observed_pair_gain_range_percent': [min(p['throughput_change_percent'] for p in pairs), max(p['throughput_change_percent'] for p in pairs)],
    'scope': {'gpu_count': 64, 'data_parallel_racks': 1, 'training_batch_size': 1024, 'optimizer_schedule_batch_size': 11264, 'steps_per_arm': 28, 'scored_relative_steps_inclusive': [8, 27]},
    'inference': 'Two exploratory matched pairs. The reverse-order pair was selected after inspecting the first positive screen. The observed range is not a confidence interval; no acceptance uncertainty interval is claimed.',
}
Path('/tmp/hero-registration-two-screen-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
